entries.text: SELECT max(block_number)::text AS block, max(timestamp)::text AS ts FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1
SELECT max(block_number)::text AS block, max(timestamp)::text AS ts FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1

SELECT wallet FROM ( SELECT owner AS wallet FROM matchbox.lock_positions WHERE network = $1 AND owner > $2 UNION SELECT actor FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1 AND actor > $2 AND action_type = ANY($4::text[]) ) w WHERE wallet <> ALL($5::text[]) ORDER BY wallet LIMIT $3

SELECT contract_address, token_id::text, owner, amount::text, unlock_at::text, is_permanent, created_at::text FROM matchbox.lock_positions WHERE network = $1 AND owner = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT is_withdrawn AND NOT is_merged ORDER BY owner, contract_address, token_id
SELECT voter_contract, token_id::text, gauge, current_weight::text, last_updated_at::text FROM matchbox.votes WHERE network = $1 AND is_active AND token_id = ANY($2::numeric[])

SELECT e.* FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS w(wallet) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tx_hash, log_index::text, block_number::text, timestamp::text, action_type, source, actor, recipient, token_id::text, amount::text, duration::text, prev_duration::text, post_duration::text, prev_is_permanent, post_is_permanent, merge_source_token_id::text, merge_dest_token_id::text, token, gauge, weight::text, boostable_token_id::text, boost::text, epoch_start::text, contract_address FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1 AND actor = w.wallet AND action_type = ANY($3::text[]) ORDER BY timestamp DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT $4 ) e
SELECT DISTINCT gauge, reward_contract, token FROM matchbox.reward_deposits WHERE network = $1 AND gauge = ANY($2::text[]) AND epoch_start >= $3

SELECT contract_address, count(DISTINCT owner)::int AS lockers, sum(amount)::text AS amount FROM matchbox.lock_positions WHERE network = $1 AND NOT is_withdrawn AND NOT is_merged GROUP BY contract_address
SELECT coalesce(sum(current_weight), 0)::text AS weight FROM matchbox.votes WHERE network = $1 AND is_active AND voter_contract = ANY($2::text[])
SELECT count(DISTINCT tx_hash)::int AS votes FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1 AND action_type = 'BOOST_VOTE' AND source IN ('POOLS_VOTER', 'VALIDATORS_VOTER') AND timestamp >= $2

SELECT epoch_start::text, voter_source, gauge, token, sum(amount)::text AS amount, count(*)::int AS deposits FROM matchbox.reward_deposits WHERE network = $1 AND epoch_start >= $2 GROUP BY epoch_start, voter_source, gauge, token

SELECT tx_hash, log_index::text, block_number::text, timestamp::text, action_type, source, actor, recipient, token_id::text, amount::text, duration::text, prev_duration::text, post_duration::text, prev_is_permanent, post_is_permanent, merge_source_token_id::text, merge_dest_token_id::text, token, gauge, weight::text, boostable_token_id::text, boost::text, epoch_start::text, contract_address FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1 AND action_type = ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY timestamp DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT $3
SELECT count(DISTINCT tx_hash)::int AS total FROM matchbox.activity_events WHERE network = $1 AND action_type = ANY($2::text[]) AND timestamp >= $3

WITH pools AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pool, gauge FROM matchbox.contracts WHERE network = $1 AND kind = 'gauge' AND pool IS NOT NULL AND gauge IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (g, epoch) g AS gauge, source, epoch::text AS epoch_start, total_weight::text AS weight FROM ( SELECT coalesce(p.gauge, e.gauge) AS g, e.source, e.timestamp - (e.timestamp % 604800) AS epoch, e.total_weight, e.timestamp, e.log_index FROM matchbox.activity_events e LEFT JOIN pools p ON p.pool = e.gauge WHERE e.network = $1 AND e.action_type IN ('BOOST_VOTE', 'BOOST_ABSTAIN') AND e.total_weight IS NOT NULL AND e.gauge IS NOT NULL AND e.timestamp >= $2 ) x ORDER BY g, epoch, timestamp DESC, log_index DESC
